content.text: I have sufficient coverage now. Let me compile the structured survey.

items.name: OpenAI News
items.detail: OpenAI's official announcements/research blog; publishes an official RSS feed, unusual among frontier labs.

items.name: Anthropic News
items.detail: Anthropic's official blog for research, product and policy posts; no official RSS/Atom feed is published, only community-maintained mirrors exist (e.g. rsshub, GitHub Action scrapers).

items.name: Google DeepMind Blog
items.detail: Official research and product blog for Google DeepMind, covering both DeepMind and Google AI research; publishes an official RSS feed.

items.name: NVIDIA Blog
items.detail: NVIDIA's official corporate blog covering AI hardware, platforms and partner announcements; company-wide feed, not AI-specific.

items.name: NVIDIA Newsroom
items.detail: NVIDIA's press-release feed, distinct from the NVIDIA Blog, used for formal corporate/financial announcements.

items.name: Mistral AI News
items.detail: Mistral's official news/announcements page for model and product releases; no confirmed official RSS/Atom feed as of this survey.

items.name: Meta AI Blog
items.detail: Meta's official blog for AI research and open-weight model releases (Llama family); no confirmed official RSS feed found.

items.name: Microsoft Research Blog
items.detail: Microsoft's official research blog spanning AI and other CS topics; long-standing official RSS support.

items.name: Hugging Face Blog
items.detail: Official Hugging Face company/community blog covering open models, libraries and ecosystem news; official RSS feed but has had reported formatting quirks (missing per-item links in some readers).

items.name: Hugging Face Daily Papers
items.detail: Hugging Face's community-curated daily feed of notable arXiv papers, widely used as a discovery layer since Papers with Code's 2025 shutdown.

items.name: xAI News
items.detail: xAI's (Elon Musk's lab) official announcements page for Grok models; no dedicated RSS feed identified.

items.name: Cohere Blog
items.detail: Cohere's official blog for enterprise LLM product and research announcements; native RSS support is unconfirmed/inconsistent, community-generated feeds exist as a fallback.

items.name: arXiv cs.AI
items.detail: arXiv's official daily RSS/Atom feed for new Computer Science - Artificial Intelligence submissions; the primary firehose for preprint research, not curated or vetted.

items.name: TechCrunch (AI category)
items.detail: Major tech-industry outlet with a dedicated AI vertical covering funding, product launches and lab drama; official category RSS feed.

items.name: Ars Technica (AI)
items.detail: Ars Technica's AI section, known for technically literate reporting; has a dedicated AI feed alongside its site-wide feed.

items.name: VentureBeat (AI)
items.detail: Enterprise-tech outlet with a long-running AI vertical (formerly 'AI Beat'/'VB Transform' coverage); official category RSS feed.

items.name: MIT Technology Review - Artificial Intelligence
items.detail: MIT Technology Review's AI topic page, home to 'The Algorithm' newsletter content; topic-level RSS feed available (feed availability/URL pattern should be verified before wiring in, as search results were inconsistent).

items.name: The Algorithm (MIT Technology Review)
items.detail: MIT Technology Review's flagship weekly AI newsletter, written by its AI reporting team; distributed by email, no separate confirmed RSS feed distinct from the site's AI topic feed.

items.name: WIRED (Artificial Intelligence)
items.detail: WIRED's AI tag/section, covering culture, policy and industry angles; has tag-level RSS feeds.

items.name: The Information
items.detail: Subscription tech-business outlet whose scoops (org-chart moves, compute deals, funding rounds) frequently set the news cycle for frontier labs; paywalled, no public RSS feed for AI coverage.

items.name: 404 Media
items.detail: Independent, subscriber-funded outlet doing accountability journalism on AI companies (scraping, labor, copyright); full-text RSS feed for subscribers.

items.name: Platformer
items.detail: Casey Newton's newsletter on platforms and AI-industry power dynamics, co-produced with the Hard Fork podcast; free RSS feed carries excerpts only, full text is paid.

items.name: Axios AI+
items.detail: Axios's AI-focused newsletter vertical; no dedicated public RSS feed identified separate from Axios's general feeds.

items.name: Stratechery
items.detail: Ben Thompson's strategy-analysis newsletter, frequently covering AI-lab business models and platform shifts; paid RSS feed for subscribers.

items.name: Import AI
items.detail: Jack Clark's (Anthropic co-founder) long-running weekly newsletter analyzing frontier research and policy, publishing since 2016; Substack-hosted with a standard feed.

items.name: The Batch (DeepLearning.AI)
items.detail: Andrew Ng's weekly newsletter/site summarizing AI business, research, and culture news with a practitioner slant; has an RSS feed.

items.name: Interconnects
items.detail: Nathan Lambert's (Allen Institute for AI) technical newsletter on frontier model training, RLHF and post-training methods, read heavily inside labs; Substack-based feed.

items.name: Don't Worry About the Vase
items.detail: Zvi Mowshowitz's long-form weekly 'AI #N' roundup synthesizing the week's model releases, papers, and policy news with heavy annotation; Substack feed.

items.name: AI as Normal Technology (formerly AI Snake Oil)
items.detail: Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor's (Princeton) skeptical, evidence-driven newsletter on AI capability claims and policy, rebranded from 'AI Snake Oil'; Substack-based feed.

items.name: Simon Willison's Weblog
items.detail: Practitioner-focused blog on LLM tooling, model releases and prompt engineering from the Datasette/Django creator; long-standing Atom feed.

items.name: Latent Space
items.detail: swyx and Alessio Fanelli's newsletter and podcast aimed at AI engineers, featuring interviews with researchers and founders; Substack feed.

items.name: Ben's Bites
items.detail: High-frequency AI product/launch news digest, one of the largest AI-specific newsletters by subscriber count; RSS availability via third-party aggregators, no confirmed native feed.

items.name: TLDR AI
items.detail: Daily bullet-point digest of AI news, research and tools aimed at engineers, part of the TLDR newsletter family; feed availability is via third-party mirrors, no confirmed native RSS.

items.name: The Neuron
items.detail: Daily AI newsletter with a large general-audience readership, focused on practical AI use and news summaries; no confirmed RSS feed.

items.name: Last Week in AI
items.detail: Weekly news-roundup podcast and newsletter summarizing the past week's AI stories, research and lab announcements.

input.summary: AI-industry trade press splits into three layers a serious reader triangulates daily: (1) official lab/vendor channels (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Nvidia, Mistral, Meta, Microsoft Research, Hugging Face, xAI, Cohere) for primary announcements, where RSS support is inconsistent -- OpenAI and DeepMind publish clean feeds, Anthropic and Mistral notably do not, forcing reliance on community-maintained scrapers; (2) broad tech-business outlets with dedicated AI verticals (TechCrunch, Ars Technica, VentureBeat, MIT Technology Review, WIRED, The Information, 404 Media, Platformer, Axios), most of which do carry AI-specific RSS feeds, though top-tier subscription outlets like The Information withhold feeds behind paywalls; and (3) independent insider newsletters written by practitioners and researchers (Import AI, The Batch, Interconnects, Don't Worry About the Vase, AI as Normal Technology, Simon Willison, Latent Space, Ben's Bites, TLDR AI), almost all Substack-hosted with standard feed conventions. A fourth, adjacent layer is raw research signal -- arXiv's cs.AI feed and Hugging Face's Daily Papers -- which the trade press itself draws from; Papers with Code, once a staple here, was retired by Meta in mid-2025. Feed URLs for smaller/independent newsletters were confirmed via search but not all were independently fetched, so treat any marked 'unconfirmed' as needing a live check before wiring into the pipeline.

structured_output.summary: AI-industry trade press splits into three layers a serious reader triangulates daily: (1) official lab/vendor channels (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Nvidia, Mistral, Meta, Microsoft Research, Hugging Face, xAI, Cohere) for primary announcements, where RSS support is inconsistent -- OpenAI and DeepMind publish clean feeds, Anthropic and Mistral notably do not, forcing reliance on community-maintained scrapers; (2) broad tech-business outlets with dedicated AI verticals (TechCrunch, Ars Technica, VentureBeat, MIT Technology Review, WIRED, The Information, 404 Media, Platformer, Axios), most of which do carry AI-specific RSS feeds, though top-tier subscription outlets like The Information withhold feeds behind paywalls; and (3) independent insider newsletters written by practitioners and researchers (Import AI, The Batch, Interconnects, Don't Worry About the Vase, AI as Normal Technology, Simon Willison, Latent Space, Ben's Bites, TLDR AI), almost all Substack-hosted with standard feed conventions. A fourth, adjacent layer is raw research signal -- arXiv's cs.AI feed and Hugging Face's Daily Papers -- which the trade press itself draws from; Papers with Code, once a staple here, was retired by Meta in mid-2025. Feed URLs for smaller/independent newsletters were confirmed via search but not all were independently fetched, so treat any marked 'unconfirmed' as needing a live check before wiring into the pipeline.
